text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see... Ah, there she is! 
Across the street...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Sachiko-saaaan!

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm? Hmmm~? ...Oh, my! 
Yes! Hello, hello, helloooo~♪"

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"Long time no see, Lady Tact! 
My, my~, I haven't seen you in just a 
little while, 
and you've grown even more dependable!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...This friendly lady is Sachiko. 
She is reportedly a housekeeper 
at Daring Tact's family home.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe, I'll do my best so you can see 
an even more dependable side of me, 
Sachiko. 
Now then, shall we begin our sightseeing 
tour?"

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah~... Tokyo is as incredible as ever, 
isn't it! 
There are more people than cows! Ufufu♪"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Indeed. It surprised me as well.
choice_data_list:
Still, she's working hard to get used to 
it.

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, yes! Ever since she was 
thiiiis tiny, my lady has always been 
such a hard worker, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
My lady hasn't changed one bit since back 
then...

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: "Sachiko! I'm home!"

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, welcome ho—goodness me! 
My lady, you're covered in mud! 
And there are leaves all over your hair!"

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Ufufu... Guess what? 
I saw a bear!"

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text: A bear!?!?

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"It caught a salmon with just one paw! 
Isn't that amazing? Just one paw!"

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"She was so innocent and cheerful about 
it, 
but my blood ran cold~..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Back then, well... 
I assure you, I now know how to interact 
with them properly."
choice_data_list:
So she's been close with nature since 
childhood, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, yes! But still! 
Our young lady isn't just about that! 
She is truly a magnificent 'young lady,' 
you know...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I have returned. 
Mother, the lilies in the mountains—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh? 
Sachiko, why are you in such a rush?"

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"Oh dear, my lady! 
The truth is, the mistress suddenly 
fell ill just a moment ago...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Mother did...!? 
Is she alright?"

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. However, the doctor told her she 
must rest thoroughly."

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"...The problem is, 
the mistress's former mentor 
is scheduled to visit today..."

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"They seem to already be in the 
neighborhood, 
so we must inform them right away..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...They have come all this way, 
from so far away. 
Having to turn right back around would be 
awful."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I will receive our guest.

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"What!? But, my lady... 
You just got home, looking like that—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I will be back in five minutes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Thank you for waiting.

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"To get ready in five minutes 
when she was covered head to toe in mud... 
or so I thought."

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, yes. 
It was just like magic had been cast in an 
instant. 
There my lady stood."

text_block_list.name: Guest
text_block_list.text:
"My goodness... Tact. 
You have grown into such a splendid young 
lady."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much 
for coming all this way 
to visit us today."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"In my mother's stead, I will be 
hosting you today. 
Please make yourself at home."

text_block_list.name: Guest
text_block_list.text:
"My... 
In that case, I will gladly accept your 
hospitality."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Big sister~! 
You're back............"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Ah... I-I'm sorry...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Come over here. 
Let's greet our guest properly, 
just like Mother always does."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hello... 
Welcome to our home...!"

text_block_list.name: Guest
text_block_list.text:
"My, my...! Hello there. 
You are just as composed and polite as 
your older sister."

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"...My lady back then 
was already so very dignified, you see."

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"No one could ever have guessed 
that she had been covered in mud 
in the mountains just minutes before~!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Please, Sachiko... 
Forget that story already."

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"My! You already understand my lady well 
enough 
to say that!? 
Oh my, oh my goodness... well now~~!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer has taken great care of me, 
after all. 
...Right?"

text_block_list.name: Sachiko
text_block_list.text:
"My, my~~!? You're interested!? 
Then here we go! That was the time when my 
lady 
returned from the freezing cold of Cape 
Erimo—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"S-Sachiko! 
I will tell the rest myself...!"
